command:
# G0c-b (#8): probe-length sanity check against RODA v205 hash.k2d. For each workload class, 10k
# lookups drawn uniformly (reservoir, seed 1) from the lookups classify would make on the staged
# 200k-pair subset (internal/mmscan with RODA's opts.k2d, classify.Tokens' dedup rule), each
# resolved with anonymous point GETs: a 64 KiB window from the home slot, extended while the probe
# continues (and wrapped at the end of the table), probes counted by chash.Probe itself.
# Reads: the in-region copies (make stage-reads), each checked against its sha256 metadata and
# its SOURCE.
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
fail() { ak2_say "ERROR: $*"; exit 1; }
hex64() { [[ $1 =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; }
# AK2_DATASETS: RODA hash.k2d first, then RODA opts.k2d, then (probes only) the staged reads.
set -- $AK2_DATASETS
U=${1#s3://}; RB=${U%%/*}; HK=${U#*/}
U=${2#s3://}; OK=${U#*/}
URL="https://$RB.s3.$AK2_REGION.amazonaws.com/$HK"
s3a() { aws s3api --no-sign-request --region "$AK2_REGION" "$@"; }

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git tar gzip jq > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1 || { tail -20 "$W/dnf.log"; fail "dnf install failed"; }
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo" || fail "clone failed"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA" || fail "checkout $SHA failed"
ak2_say "checkout $SHA head=$(git -C "$W/repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
GOV=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2}' "$W/repo/go.mod")
curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 "https://go.dev/dl/go$GOV.linux-arm64.tar.gz" -o "$W/go.tgz" || fail "Go download failed"
tar -xzf "$W/go.tgz" -C "$W" || fail "Go unpack failed"
export PATH="$W/go/bin:$PATH"
(cd "$W/repo" && go build -trimpath -o bin/ ./cmd/k2probe) > "$W/build.out" 2>&1 || { tail -30 "$W/build.out"; fail "build failed"; }
K2P="$W/repo/bin/k2probe"
ak2_say "go: $(go version); k2probe built; nproc $(nproc); $(free -g | awk '/Mem:/{print "mem_gib " $2}')"

# The object the instance reads: ETag and size from its own head-object (the post script checks
# them against the manifest's launch-time head-object). Every ranged GET sends If-Match: ETag.
ak2_phase head
s3a head-object --bucket "$RB" --key "$HK" > "$W/head-hash.k2d.json" || fail "head-object hash.k2d failed"
ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$RB"
ak2_push "$W/head-hash.k2d.json"
ETAG=$(jq -r '.ETag | gsub("\"";"")' "$W/head-hash.k2d.json")
SIZE=$(jq -r .ContentLength "$W/head-hash.k2d.json")
ak2_say "hash.k2d etag=$ETAG size=$SIZE version=$(jq -r '.VersionId // "null"' "$W/head-hash.k2d.json")"
[ -n "$ETAG" ] && [ "$SIZE" -gt 0 ] || fail "no ETag/size for hash.k2d"

ak2_phase fetch
s3a get-object --bucket "$RB" --key "$OK" "$W/opts.k2d" > "$W/opts.k2d.get.json" || fail "GET opts.k2d failed"
ak2_req GetObject 1 "$RB"
ak2_push "$W/opts.k2d"; ak2_push "$W/opts.k2d.get.json"
# check_obj FILE KEY: FILE is non-empty and its sha256 equals the object's sha256 metadata.
check_obj() {
  local f=$1 key=$2 s want got
  s=$(stat -c%s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  # aws s3 cp: one GET below the 8 MiB multipart threshold, else 8 MiB ranged GETs.
  ak2_req GetObject $(( s < 8388608 ? 1 : (s + 8388607) / 8388608 )) "$CB"
  want=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$CB" --key "$key" --query Metadata.sha256 --output text)
  ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$CB"
  got=$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  ak2_say "staged $key bytes=$s sha256=$got object-metadata=$want"
  hex64 "$want" && hex64 "$got" && [ "$got" = "$want" ] && [ "$s" -gt 0 ] \
    || fail "$key does not match its sha256 metadata (or is empty)"
}
U=${3#s3://}; CB=${U%%/*}; K=${U#*/}; RK=${K%/*}
RD="$W/reads"; mkdir -p "$RD"
SAMPLES=()
for r in $AK2_ACCESSIONS; do
  for f in "${r}_200000.SOURCE" "${r}_200000_1.fq" "${r}_200000_2.fq"; do
    ak2_stage "s3://$CB/$RK/$f" "$RD/$f" || fail "stage of $f failed"
    check_obj "$RD/$f" "$RK/$f"
  done
  for m in 1 2; do
    f="${r}_200000_$m.fq"
    h=$(sha256sum "$RD/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)
    grep -qx "sha256 $h $f" "$RD/${r}_200000.SOURCE" || fail "$f does not match ${r}_200000.SOURCE"
  done
  ak2_say "reads $r verified against SOURCE"
  SAMPLES+=(-sample "$r=$RD/${r}_200000_1.fq,$RD/${r}_200000_2.fq")
done

ak2_phase probes
O="$W/probes"; mkdir -p "$O"
# The G0c-a pass over the same object (k2probe checks its ETag), from the cloned commit: its
# miss_probes_from_runs is the second miss expectation.
RS="$W/repo/results/g0c/20261006-091414-1b5fe49/out/pass/summary.json"
[ -s "$RS" ] || fail "no G0c-a pass summary at $RS"
"$K2P" probes -url "$URL" -etag "$ETAG" -size "$SIZE" -opts "$W/opts.k2d" "${SAMPLES[@]}" \
  -n 10000 -seed 1 -window-kib 64 -workers 32 -runs-summary "$RS" -out "$O"
RC=$?
ak2_say "k2probe probes rc=$RC"
N=$(jq -r '.get_requests // 0' "$O/summary.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
# get_requests: every ranged GET k2probe made, counted on the one source all its workers share
# (the header read, each 64 KiB window and each extension), every retry attempt included;
# get_retries is how many of them were retries.
ak2_req GetObject-range "${N:-0}" "$RB"

ak2_phase push
PF=0
for f in "$O"/*; do ak2_push "$f" "probes/$(basename "$f")" || PF=$((PF + 1)); done
ak2_say "G0c-b done rc=$RC push_failures=$PF"
[ "$RC" != 0 ] && exit "$RC"
[ "$PF" = 0 ] || exit 1
exit 0
